title: Chocolate Ginger Peach Icebox Cake
changes_from_base: A cocoa chiffon cake split and filled with a frozen ginger-peach semifreddo with gingersnap pieces, then glazed in chocolate, instead of ice cream layers.
summary: A striped chocolate and ginger sponge cake layered with a peach semifreddo and wrapped in a shiny dark chocolate glaze and crushed gingersnaps.

ingredients.note: 100 g with the flour, 50 g for the whites

ingredients.item: large egg yolks, at room temperature
large egg whites, at room temperature
fine sea salt or table salt

ingredients.note: 50 g for the purée, 200 g for the syrup

ingredients.item: light corn syrup or glucose syrup
large egg whites, at room temperature
fine sea salt or table salt
dark corn syrup or golden syrup

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Whisk together 62 g cake flour, 40 g cocoa powder, 100 g sugar, baking powder and 1 tsp ground ginger, then whisk in the egg yolks, oil and vanilla before stirring in 60 ml hot water to make a thick batter.

steps.title: Whisk
steps.text: Whisk the 4 egg whites with ½ tsp salt to soft peaks, whisk in 50 g sugar to firm glossy peaks, then fold into the chocolate batter, spread in the tin and bake at 165 °C for 25-30 min until a skewer comes out clean; cool completely and split into two layers.

steps.title: Bloom
steps.text: Soak 7 g gelatine in 3 tbsp water for 5 min, microwave for 30 s and leave to cool for 5-10 min.

steps.title: Blend
steps.text: Blend the peaches, fresh ginger, 50 g sugar and vanilla, sieve into a bowl and stir in the crushed gingersnap pieces.

steps.title: Meringue
steps.text: Dissolve 200 g sugar, 60 ml water and the light corn or glucose syrup, boil to 114 °C, then whisk 4 egg whites with ¼ tsp salt to soft peaks, pour in the hot syrup and whisk until cool and glossy, about 7 min, before beating in the gelatine.

steps.title: Assemble
steps.text: Fold the meringue into the peach mixture, spread over the bottom cake layer in the tin, top with the second layer and freeze for at least 6 h.

steps.title: Glaze
steps.text: Bring 120 ml cream and 120 ml dark syrup to a simmer, whisk in 255 g chopped dark chocolate until smooth, then coat the top and sides of the cake in two layers, freezing briefly between coats.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Press gingersnap biscuits around the sides, freeze for about 1 h, then slice with a knife warmed in hot water and dried between cuts.

tips: Use pasteurised egg whites for the semifreddo if serving pregnant women, young children, older people or anyone unwell, as it may not fully reach 71 °C.
Check the gelatine packet, as it is sourced from beef.
Warm the knife and wipe it dry between slices so the glaze and semifreddo layers stay neat.
Don't taste the raw dough or batter: raw flour and raw egg aren't safe to eat until baked.
storage: Keep the cake well wrapped in the freezer and slice it straight from frozen with a warm, dried knife.
